lines.en: It’s been just under twenty-four hours since I rode the ferris wheel again.
lines.zh: 距离我又一次坐上摩天轮，还不到二十四小时。

lines.en: And to think I almost didn’t pick up the phone.
lines.zh: 想想看，我差点就没接那个电话。

lines.en: It isn’t often that Tsuneyo’s name pops up on the screen, so I assumed she was just dialing my number on accident at first.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 的名字出现在屏幕上并不常见，所以一开始我还以为她是不小心拨错了我的号码。

lines.en: But, for whatever reason (whether that reason be fate or luck or anything in between), I did. And I must now deal with the consequences.
lines.zh: 但不知出于什么原因（无论那是命运、运气，还是介于两者之间的什么），我接了。而现在，我必须面对随之而来的后果。

lines.en: And the reason I say that like it’s a bad thing is because, right now, it {i}is{/i} a bad thing.
lines.zh: 我之所以说得好像这是件坏事，是因为此刻它{i}确实是{/i}件坏事。

lines.en: How am I supposed to care about the same timeless world that sodomized me and left me catatonic on top of a roof, staring down with widened eyes at a puddle of my semen?
lines.zh: 我要怎么去在乎那个永恒循环的世界？那个把我鸡奸、让我在屋顶上僵直地躺着、睁大眼睛低头盯着自己一滩精液的世界？

lines.en: I’m not. That’s ridiculous. {i}All{/i} of this is ridiculous. And now Tsuneyo is getting roped into it again just so she can be purged in another couple months after getting all of our hopes up.
lines.zh: 我不会的。那太荒谬了。{i}这一切{/i}都太荒谬了。而现在 Tsuneyo 又被卷了进来，只为了在几个月后再次被清除，在我们所有人刚刚燃起希望之后。
真是累人。

lines.en: But hey, maybe this can finally be the opening I need to shove my dick inside of her next and knock another off the list.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，也许这终于能成为我需要的那个切口——好让我接下来把鸡巴塞进她体内，再从清单上划掉一个。

lines.en: If she’s lucky, maybe {i}she’ll{/i} disappear too and get sent back to a time before she ever met me. That’s how I’ll rationalize this. That’ll make this work for everyone.
lines.zh: 如果她运气好，也许{i}她{/i}也会消失，被送回她遇见我之前的时间。我就这么给自己找理由吧。这样对大家都有好处。

lines.en: Or maybe she’ll get even luckier and start from the beginning — trapped inside the confines of that dingy fucking ramen shop, where she will both live and die without ever experiencing life outside the walls.
lines.zh: 或者她会更走运，从头开始——被困在那家昏暗得要命的拉面店的四壁之内，在那里生，在那里死，永远体验不到墙外的生活。

lines.en: I think we all need something like that.
lines.zh: 我觉得我们都需要那样一个东西。

lines.en: A forceful reminder that each day is just a bridge between then and now- and that the future we all look forward to never actually comes. All we’ll get is one more unfortunate present.
lines.zh: 一个强硬的提醒：每一天都只是连接“那时”与“此刻”的一座桥——而我们所有人翘首以盼的未来，其实永远不会到来。我们所能得到的，只是一个又一个不幸的当下。
: Sensei——

lines.en: And all I’ll get is tired.
lines.zh: 而我所能得到的，只有疲惫。

lines.en: : Sorry I’m late. I always wind up getting lost whenever I’m over here.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我来晚了。我一到这边就老是迷路。
: 没关系。Makoto 呢？
: 她……决定不来了。
: 什么？

lines.en: : Yeah...that’s kind of a thing she’s been doing lately.
lines.zh: : 嗯……她最近一直在搞这一出。

lines.en: : Any time I want to talk about {i}world{/i} stuff, she just shrugs it off and says she doesn’t want to be bothered. And it’s really starting to get on my nerves since it’s, like...
lines.zh: : 每次我想谈{i}世界{/i}的事，她就耸耸肩说不想被打扰。这真的开始让我火大了，因为这就像……

lines.en: : It’s like she’s treating this like a game.
lines.zh: : 就像她把这当成一场游戏。
: 我明白了。

lines.en: : That’s it? I figured you’d sound a little more disappointed.
lines.zh: : 就这样？我以为你会听起来更失望一点。

lines.en: : It’s not worth it. And, honestly, {i}not{/i} getting involved is probably better for her. It’ll save her the anguish of her expectations being repeatedly brutalized before her very eyes.
lines.zh: : 不值得。而且说实话，{i}不{/i}掺和进来对她来说可能更好。这样她就不必一遍遍眼睁睁看着自己的期待被残忍地碾碎。

lines.en: : Sensei...come on...we need to work together during times like this.
lines.zh: : Sensei……别这样……这种时候我们得一起努力。
: 这也是{i}她{/i}希望看到的。

lines.en: : Are we thinking of the same person? Because the person {i}I’m{/i} thinking of {i}absolutely{/i} would not have wanted that. She was rooting for you to disappear the entire time. You {i}know{/i} that.
lines.zh: : 我们说的是同一个人吗？因为{i}我{/i}心里想的那个人{i}绝对{/i}不会希望这样。她从头到尾都在盼着你消失。你{i}知道{/i}的。

lines.en: : I know that she {i}said{/i} that. And, call me an optimist, but I like to think she didn’t actually feel that way. She wanted to solve this more than anyone.
lines.zh: : 我知道她是那么{i}说{/i}的。不过，就算我乐观吧，我更愿意相信她其实不是那样想的。她比任何人都想解决这个问题。

lines.en: : And now that she’s gone you’re going to fill her shoes? Is that what this is?
lines.zh: : 现在她不在了，你要接替她的位置？这就是你现在在做的事？
: 你为什么这么刻薄？……

lines.en: : Because I’m {i}mad,{/i} Ayane. I’m so tired of this already and I’ve only been doing it for a {i}fraction{/i} of the time that she did. I just want it to end.
lines.zh: : 因为我{i}很生气{/i}，Ayane。我已经受够了，而我才做了她做过的那些事的{i}零头{/i}。我只想让这一切结束。

lines.en: : If you wanted it to end, you wouldn’t have asked me to come to Tojo Ramen in the middle of the night just so we could talk to Tsuneyo together.
lines.zh: : 如果你想让它结束，就不会叫我半夜跑到 Tojo Ramen，就为了我们一起去跟 Tsuneyo 谈。

lines.en: : I get that things are hard right now. They’re hard for me too. But it’s both a blessing and a curse that we have what is theoretically {i}forever{/i} to get over that.
lines.zh: : 我知道现在很难受。我也一样难受。但理论上我们拥有{i}永恒{/i}来熬过这一点，这既是祝福，也是诅咒。

lines.en: : That’s not a luxury we’re supposed to have. And all dwelling on the negatives will do is create a situation where it feels like you’re stuck in quicksand.
lines.zh: : 我们本不该拥有这种奢侈。而一味沉溺于负面情绪，只会让你觉得自己像是陷进了流沙里。

lines.en: : That’s not a good analogy. You have to {i}stop{/i} struggling to get out of quicksand. Fighting back against it will just kill you faster.
lines.zh: : 这个比喻不太对。陷进流沙里是{i}不能挣扎{/i}的。越是反抗，死得越快。

lines.en: : Well, the way I see it, {i}you’re{/i} the one who’s fighting back right now. {i}You’re{/i} struggling harder than anyone.
lines.zh: : 可在我看来，现在在反抗的人{i}是你{/i}。{i}你{/i}比谁都在挣扎。

lines.en: : This is a mental battle, not a physical one. And if you’re spending weeks at a time internally screaming at yourself, {i}you’re{/i} going to get killed. Not me.
lines.zh: : 这是一场精神层面的战斗，不是身体上的。如果你一连几周都在心里对自己尖叫，被杀死的人{i}会是你{/i}。不是我。

lines.en: : So take a deep breath, okay?...
lines.zh: : 所以深呼吸，好吗？……
: 冷静下来。

lines.en: : We’ll get through this together. You...me...Makoto...and maybe even Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我们会一起挺过去的。你……我……Makoto……也许还有 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : I’m just tired of getting my hopes up, Ayane. I’m so tired. I’m hanging on by a thread right now.
lines.zh: : 我只是厌倦了一次次燃起希望，Ayane。我太累了。我现在就吊在一根线上。

lines.en: : Well, you’re in luck. Because I just-so-happen to know how to sew. And there’s no way I’m letting you disappear on me when you’re all I have left now. Got it?
lines.zh: : 嗯，你运气不错。因为我刚好会缝东西。而且你现在是我仅剩的人了，我绝不会让你从我面前消失。明白了吗？
: 我们能不能就这么逃走？

lines.en: : Sure. But do you mind if I get something to eat first? I’m kind of craving ramen right now.
lines.zh: : 可以。不过你介意我先吃点东西吗？我现在有点想吃拉面。
: Ayane——
: 一切都会好起来的。
: 我们是一起面对的。

lines.en: : Welcome to Tojo Ramen. Please take-
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临 Tojo Ramen。请——

lines.en: : Hey, Tsuneyo. Sensei gave me the run-down about your theme park reunion thingy. Is now a good time to...you know...talk about that?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Tsuneyo。Sensei 跟我讲了你们在游乐园“重逢”那件事。现在方便……你知道的……聊聊那个吗？

lines.en: : I expected three people. What has become of the class president?
lines.zh: : 我预计会来三个人。那位班长怎么了？

lines.en: : Makoto couldn’t get out of work tonight, but you don’t need to worry about her.
lines.zh: : Makoto 今晚加班来不了，不过你不用担心她。
: 我明白了。

lines.en: : You look...better than you did when we left off last night.
lines.zh: : 你看起来……比昨晚我们分开时好多了。

lines.en: : I’ve had time to evaluate the situation and am now raring to go and ready to learn more. But before that, I must apologize for raising my voice at you.
lines.zh: : 我已经有时间审视了现状，现在跃跃欲试，准备了解更多。但在此之前，我必须为对你大声说话的事道歉。

lines.en: : That was very impolite of me, and I am prepared to sever my pinkie-finger as penance for my actions.
lines.zh: : 那是非常失礼的行为，我已准备好切断自己的小指，为我的行为赎罪。

lines.en: : Thanks. I’ll take the one on your dominant hand.
lines.zh: : 谢了。我要你惯用手上那根。
: 如你所愿。

lines.en: : No, it will {i}not{/i} be done! What’s wrong with you two?!
lines.zh: : 不，{i}不行{/i}！你们两个怎么回事？！

lines.en: : If we are going to list our problems, I recommend that we start with him. His flaws are much more glaringly obvious than mine and can likely be rattled off in a matter of minutes.
lines.zh: : 如果要列举问题，我建议从他开始。他的缺点比我的明显得多，大概几分钟就能数完。

lines.en: : If I’m going to start, I’d like to admit right out of the gate that I’ve been the end of at least ten pay-it-forward chains this year alone.
lines.zh: : 如果由我先来，我想开门见山地承认：光是今年，我就终结了至少十条“爱心传递”的链条。
: 好过分！那些说不定是我发起的。

lines.en: : My turn. I personally believe that capital punishment is justified for those who leave a restaurant without finishing a dish. I’ve been told by some that this can be considered a character flaw.
lines.zh: : 轮到我了。我个人认为，对那些在餐厅里剩着菜不吃完就走的人，判处死刑是完全正当的。有人告诉我，这可以被视为一种性格缺陷。

lines.en: : Ayane’s biggest flaw is that she’s too detail-oriented and caring.
lines.zh: : Ayane 最大的缺点是太注重细节、太爱操心。

lines.en: : Why did you have to pick out the flaws that make me sound like I’m in a job interview?
lines.zh: : 你为什么专挑那些听起来像是在面试的缺点啊？

lines.en: : At the risk of the introductory portion of this conversation dragging on any longer, may I ask if you two will be eating or drinking anything tonight? I personally recommend the “everything.”
lines.zh: : 冒着这段开场白继续拖下去的风险，我能否问问二位今晚要不要吃点或喝点什么？我个人推荐“全都要”。

lines.en: : {i}The{/i} everything? Is that some kind of special?
lines.zh: : “{i}全{/i}都要”？是什么特供吗？
: 不，就是全部的东西。

lines.en: : I think I’m okay actually. Ordering anything will just force even more time between you knowing the secrets of the universe and you {i}not{/i} knowing the secrets of the universe. And none of us want that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我就{i}不用{/i}了。点任何东西都只会让你知晓宇宙秘密的时间又往后拖。而我们谁都不想那样。

lines.en: : I can not wait to sell this information to the highest bidder and use the profits to purchase a larger ramen shop.
lines.zh: : 我等不及要把这些情报卖给出价最高的人，然后用利润买一家更大的拉面店了。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, anyone you try to reveal these secrets to will probably just interrupt you. And, on the off chance they don’t, they’ll think you’re either insane or trying to scam them.
lines.zh: : 不幸的是，你试图向任何人透露这些秘密，他们大概都会打断你。而万一他们没打断，他们也会觉得你不是疯了，就是想骗他们。

lines.en: : That sounds like an inconvenience. I hereby relinquish my powers as the world’s first backwards soothsayer.
lines.zh: : 听起来挺麻烦的。我在此放弃自己作为世界上第一个“逆向预言者”的能力。
: 什么是{i}逆向{/i}预言者？

lines.en: : Someone who can see the past.
lines.zh: : 就是能看见过去的人。
: 我的英雄名号是“记忆女孩”。

lines.en: : Okay, well...considering this is the one scenario where having memories kind of {i}is{/i} a superpower, I’ll let you keep your hero name.
lines.zh: : 好吧……考虑到这是唯一一种“拥有记忆”反而{i}算{/i}超能力的情形，我就让你保留你的英雄名号。

lines.en: : But only {i}after{/i} listening to your “hero orientation” so your powers don’t, like...spiral out of control or something.
lines.zh: : 但前提是你要{i}先{/i}听完你的“英雄入职培训”，好让你的能力不会……失控之类的。

lines.en: : So...buckle yourself in, Memory Girl. You’re in for a pretty intense info-dump.
lines.zh: : 那么……系好安全带，记忆女孩。接下来是一段相当密集的信息倾泻。
{i}三十分钟后……{/i}
: 我明白了。

lines.en: : Do you? Because you were really silent through that entire speech and I kind of figured you’d have, like...any amount of questions about the fact that we’re in an infinitely repeating school year.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？因为我讲那一大段的时候你一直很沉默，我还以为你对“我们身处一个无限循环的学年”这件事，多少会有点问题要问。

lines.en: : In her defense, she’s heard this all before at that sleepover we had.
lines.zh: : 替她说句公道话，我们在那次过夜聚会时，这些她都已经听过了。

lines.en: : Yes, but she doesn’t have any {i}memories{/i} of that sleepover, so that shouldn’t be relevant.
lines.zh: : 是的，可她没有那次过夜聚会的{i}记忆{/i}，所以那应该不相干。

lines.en: : I am Memory Girl. I have memories of everything.
lines.zh: : 我是记忆女孩。我拥有一切的记忆。

lines.en: : I remember that sleepover well. I was just unaware that it was actually a {i}memory{/i} until I learned that these “visions” were not simply visions at all.
lines.zh: : 那次过夜聚会我记得很清楚。只是在我明白这些“幻象”根本不是幻象之前，我并不知道那其实是一段{i}记忆{/i}。

lines.en: : And I have to say I am thankful for this as I was beginning to worry that I was just having very strange and specific fantasies.
lines.zh: : 而且我得说，我很感激这一点，因为我已经开始担心自己只是在产生一些非常奇怪而具体的幻想了。

lines.en: : Do you remember how that sleepover ended, though? Because I’m pretty sure that’s when one of the resets started.
lines.zh: : 不过你还记得那次过夜聚会是怎么结束的吗？因为我挺确定，其中一次重置就是从那时开始的。
: 怎么结束的？……

lines.en: : I’m not quite sure. The memories don’t appear in order. They come and go, like the Produce Delivery Administration on Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定。记忆不是按顺序出现的。它们来来去去，就像农产品配送管理局在周二、周四和周日出现一样。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo left halfway through, didn’t she?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo 中途就走了，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...I remember her getting a phone call and then disappearing.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我记得她接了个电话，然后就不见了。
: 一个电话……

lines.en: : Do you remember anything like that, Tsuneyo? Not that it would definitely be relevant, but it might help us establish some sort of timeline.
lines.zh: : 你还记得类似的事吗，Tsuneyo？虽然不一定有关，但也许能帮我们建立某种时间线。

lines.en: : I apologize, but I’m unable to recall anything at this moment in time. I will remain vigilant in hopes that a new memory will approach, though.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，此刻我回忆不起任何东西。不过我会保持警惕，希望能有新的记忆浮现。

lines.en: : Nothing from the past can escape the mind of Memory Girl.
lines.zh: : 任何过去的事都逃不过记忆女孩的脑海。

lines.en: : Do you remember who else was {i}at{/i} the sleepover, Tsuneyo? Not counting anyone shorter than me because that’s a subject Sensei isn’t ready to approach yet.
lines.zh: : 你还记得那次过夜聚会{i}上{/i}还有谁吗，Tsuneyo？不算比我矮的那些人，因为那是个 Sensei 还没准备好面对的话题。
: 挺含蓄的。
: Yamo。
: Yamo？
: 她指的是 Yumi。
: 我很确定是 Yamo。

lines.en: : No, it’s definitely Yumi. Because Yumi was there. She doesn’t have any recollection of it like you do, though. So I wonder what it is that makes you different?
lines.zh: : 不，肯定是 Yumi。因为 Yumi 当时在场。不过她不像你那样对此有任何记忆。所以我在想，到底是什么让你与众不同？

lines.en: : There is only one explanation — gluten.
lines.zh: : 只有一个解释——麸质。

lines.en: : This is why they have been removing it from so many things. No one understood its powers until now. How could we have been so blind?
lines.zh: : 这就是为什么他们从那么多东西里把它去掉。直到现在才有人明白它的力量。我们怎么会瞎成这样？

lines.en: : We’ve finally figured it out, Ayane. You were right. All we needed to do was work together.
lines.zh: : 我们终于搞明白了，Ayane。你是对的。我们需要做的只是齐心协力。

lines.en: : You don’t think the old district has something to do with it, does it?
lines.zh: : 你不觉得老城区跟这事有关系吗？

lines.en: : What would the old district have to do with it?
lines.zh: : 老城区能跟这事有什么关系？

lines.en: : I’m trying to think of things the two of them have in common. And both of them are from the old district, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 我在想她们俩的共同点。她们俩都来自老城区，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...but so is Chika, and she hasn’t been involved in any of this yet. Which is great, because if I have to try explaining this to her little sister, I’m going to shoot myself with one of your guns.
lines.zh: : 嗯……可 Chika 也是，而她到现在还没卷进来。这挺好，因为如果我得跟她妹妹解释这些，我会用你的一把枪崩了自己。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s a good point. I wasn’t thinking of anyone else yet, just what Yumi and Tsuneyo share. But I think I’m at a dead end because the only other thing I can think of is D-Cups.
lines.zh: : 嗯，有道理。我还没想到别人，只是在想 Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 的共同点。不过我觉得走进死胡同了，因为我能想到的另一样东西只有 D 罩杯。

lines.en: : Who gave you permission to violate me in my own restaurant?
lines.zh: : 谁允许你在我自己的店里冒犯我的？

lines.en: : Can you think of anything else, Tsuneyo? I’m just trying to figure out what we’re supposed to do next.
lines.zh: : 你还能想到别的吗，Tsuneyo？我只是想弄明白我们下一步该做什么。

lines.en: : Because my instinct is saying to go back to Yumi, but I also don’t want to just go around in circles and wind up right back at the beginning the next time there's an apocalypse.
lines.zh: : 因为我的直觉说要回去找 Yumi，但我也不想就这么绕圈子，等下一次末日来临时又回到原点。

lines.en: : It all comes back to gluten.
lines.zh: : 一切都要回到麸质上。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, I really don’t think it’s gluten.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，我真觉得不是麸质。

lines.en: : It has to be. I watched her eat my noodles with her very mouth. There is no other explanation.
lines.zh: : 一定是。我亲眼看着她用她的嘴吃了我的面。没有别的解释。

lines.en: : What do you think, Sensei? Should we try talking to Yumi again?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢，Sensei？我们要不要再去找 Yumi 谈谈？

lines.en: : I don’t know, Ayane. I saw Yumi the other night and-
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Ayane。我前几天晚上见过 Yumi，而且——
: 等等……

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, didn’t you talk to Yumi about this already?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你不是已经跟 Yumi 谈过这些了吗？
: 什么？

lines.en: : When I last saw Yumi, she said she came here to eat dinner and that you started asking her a bunch of questions.
lines.zh: : 我上次见 Yumi 的时候，她说她来这儿吃晚饭，然后你开始问了她一堆问题。

lines.en: : I ask many people many questions. It is part of my job as the Memory Ramen Girl.
lines.zh: : 我问很多人很多问题。这是我作为“记忆拉面女孩”工作的一部分。

lines.en: : No, like {i}weird{/i} questions. Specifically about...dates and sleepovers and things like that. She compared you to me- and said you weren’t acting like yourself.
lines.zh: : 不，是{i}奇怪{/i}的问题。特别是关于……约会、过夜聚会之类的。她把你比作我——说你表现得不像你自己。

lines.en: : She does not know me very well, nor do I know her. The probability of her understanding what is or isn’t normal for me seems unlikely. Perhaps she is mistaken?
lines.zh: : 她不太了解我，我也不太了解她。她能判断什么对我正常、什么不正常的可能性似乎很低。也许是她搞错了？

lines.en: : Yumi was comparing her to {i}you?{/i} That’s weird.
lines.zh: : Yumi 把她比作{i}你{/i}？这有点怪。

lines.en: : Specifically me when I’ve “lost it.” Yumi’s around for that a lot. She’s always snapping me out of memory-lapses and blackouts and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 特别是“失了魂”时候的我。Yumi 经常在场。她总是把我从记忆断片和昏厥之类的状态里拽回来。

lines.en: : How...often does that happen to you, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那……具体来说，这种事多久发生一次？

lines.en: : A lot, but...come to think of it, you’re rarely even around when that happens, are you?
lines.zh: : 很多次，不过……这么一想，那种时候你几乎都不在场，对吧？

lines.en: : I’m there for when you’re broken during resets, but-
lines.zh: : 你在的时候，是当你在重置中崩溃的时候，但——

lines.en: : Attention, diners. I have an announcement to make.
lines.zh: : 各位顾客请注意。我要宣布一件事。
: 怎么了，Tsuneyo？

lines.en: why is it always behind you
lines.zh: 为什么它总在你身后
: {size=+20}{b}AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!{/b}{/size}
: 嗯啊！
: 没事的……只是停电了。
: 这里有时会这样。
: 可是……那个声音……
: 嗯。是很响。

lines.en: : But on the bright side, at least Tsuneyo-
lines.zh: : 不过往好处想，至少 Tsuneyo——
: Tsuneyo……不在了……

lines.en: : Tsuneyo isn’t here! This is weird, right?! She was there a second ago and now she’s gone!
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo 不在了！这很奇怪对吧？！她刚刚还在那儿，现在却不见了！
: 我……我不太……

lines.en: : Is it happening again right now?! Is it already time for the next reset?! How are we still together?! What’s going on?!
lines.zh: : 又发生了吗？！已经到下一次重置的时间了吗？！我们怎么还在一起？！到底怎么回事？！

lines.en: : Ayane...it’s okay. She probably just stepped outside without us noticing.  Tsuneyo’s weird. And this is a weird place.
lines.zh: : Ayane……没事的。她大概只是趁我们没注意走到外面去了。Tsuneyo 本来就很怪。这地方也很怪。
s0mething is wr0ng

lines.en: : Why don’t we go out there and check?
lines.zh: : 我们为什么不出去看看？
I c4nt c0ntr01 1T
: Sensei？……
TH15 15NT M3
: 走吧……我肯定她没事的。
: 你怎么了？……
: 没什么。

lines.en: : Now, quit being such a scaredy cat.
lines.zh: : 行了，别这么胆小。

lines.en: : Sensei, wait! Don’t leave without me!
lines.zh: : Sensei，等等！别丢下我！
嘿。

lines.en: i think we should stop coming here.
lines.zh: 我觉得我们不该再来这里了。

lines.en: : He who disbelieves after his having believed, not he who is compelled while his heart is at rest on account of faith, but he who opens his breast to disbelief-
lines.zh: : 凡在信奉之后又否认的人——除非是被迫的、而其心仍安于信仰——凡是胸襟向否认敞开的人——

lines.en: : On these is the wrath of God, and they shall have a grievous chastisement.
lines.zh: : 这些人将遭真主的恼怒，并将受重大的刑罚。

lines.en: : Kill the apostates. Seize them and kill them wherever you find them.
lines.zh: : 杀死那些叛教者。无论在哪里发现他们，就抓住他们、杀死他们。

lines.zh: : 杀死那些叛教者。无论在哪里发现他们，就抓住他们、杀死他们。
: Sensei……

lines.en: : This has never happened before...has it?...
lines.zh: : 这种事以前从没发生过……对吧？……

lines.en: : On these is the wrath of God, and they shall have a grievous chastisement.
lines.zh: : 这些人将遭真主的恼怒，并将受重大的刑罚。
: 没有。

lines.zh: : 杀死那些叛教者。无论在哪里发现他们，就抓住他们、杀死他们。
: 这种事以前从没发生过。

lines.zh: : 杀死那些叛教者。无论在哪里发现他们，就抓住他们、杀死他们。

lines.en: : We should probably bring her back inside now, shouldn’t we?...
lines.zh: : 我们大概该把她带回屋里去了，对吧？……

lines.en: : On these is the wrath of God, and they shall have a grievous chastisement.
lines.zh: : 这些人将遭真主的恼怒，并将受重大的刑罚。

lines.en: : We should bring her back inside.
lines.zh: : 我们该把她带回屋里。

lines.en: : {size=-2}Tsuneyo, I know you probably can’t hear me on account of how nothing that happens ever makes sense anymore, but it’s probably not the best idea to wander around naked in a neighborhood full of homeless people.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}Tsuneyo，我知道你大概听不见我说话，毕竟现在发生的一切都没道理可言，但这一带满是无家可归的人，你这样光着身子到处乱晃，恐怕不是什么好主意。{/size}

lines.en: : There are clues in a house near a lake. It started before you were born.
lines.zh: : 湖边的一栋房子里有线索。它在你出生之前就开始了。
: 湖边的一栋——

lines.en: : Sensei, Tsuneyo’s pupils are, like...completely gone.
lines.zh: : Sensei，Tsuneyo 的瞳孔……好像……完全没了。
: 无限的……春天……
: 无限的……世界……

lines.en: : On these is the wrath of God, and they shall have a grievous chastisement.
lines.zh: : 这些人将遭真主的恼怒，并将受重大的刑罚。

lines.en: : Can you help me, please? I can’t move her on my own.
lines.zh: : 你能帮帮我吗？我一个人搬不动她。

lines.en: Ayane and I escort a naked, murderous and pupil-less Tsuneyo back inside of a blacked out ramen shop.
lines.zh: Ayane 和我把赤身裸体、杀气腾腾、没有瞳孔的 Tsuneyo 护送回了那家漆黑的拉面店里。

lines.en: But the craziest part is that isn’t even the weirdest thing that happens to me tonight.
lines.zh: 但最疯狂的是，这甚至不是我今晚遇到的最怪的事。

lines.en: On the way home, I piss myself.
lines.zh: 在回家的路上，我尿了裤子。

lines.en: Guess it looks like I’m pee boy after all =/
lines.zh: 看来我终究还是“尿裤子男孩”啊 =/

{i}Tsuneyo 的好感度提升了 17！{/i}

lines.en: What? Why? She wasn’t even here.
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？她又不在场。

lines.en: {i}She masturbated to you again while all that shit was going down. I figured I’d let you know afterward so it didn’t interrupt the event.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你那边乱成一团的时候，她又对着你自慰了。我想着事后告诉你，免得打断事件。{/i}
: 哦，谢了。
: {i}不客气。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Seriously, though. Let’s not go to the old district anymore. Just let Memory Girl’s brain get wiped again.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过说真的。咱们别再去老城区了。就让记忆女孩的大脑再被清空一次吧。{/i}
: 我觉得我要疯了。
: {i}你没有。{/i}
